notes: Core farm animals (truck, toad, sheep, cow, pig, hen) are already available in activity_images or aac_extras and do not need to be re-sourced; the fringe prioritises springtime-specific vocabulary (eggs, nests, mud, rain, growth) that distinguishes this seasonal title from other Little Blue Truck books. 'Beep' is the truck's signature sound and highly motivating for students familiar with the series — search for a horn/beep symbol or create a custom cell. Lamb and chick are springtime baby-animal highlights of this book and are preferred over their parent animals (sheep, hen) which are already in existing assets.
